items.excerpt: Autodesk's Flow Studio adds 3D Editor + Canvas, letting filmmakers block shots, cameras and performance directly in 3D while AI handles final rendering. The release lays groundwork for Maya and DCC integrations and agent-driven directing.

Autodesk unwraps a Flow Studio tool aimed at the core problem of synthetic filmmaking: control. Adding a 3D layer to the edit is meant to make generative shots feel less random and more directed, the company says.

An SEC filing names ILM and Pixar among the units getting machine-learning investment inside Disney, alongside Disney Research Studios and Imagineering. Disney pledges a process that stays "human-centered, artist-driven," landing right after job cuts.

Bob Gaudette and Kirk Hipkiss launch Nolia, a Toronto AI film and TV studio built around original IP, with 'The Little Cloud Thief' in development as feature and series. Gaudette's 8-minute AI short took the $50K Grand Prix at this year's Runway AI Festival.

Eli Roth first described the animated sequences in 'Ice Cream Man' as traditionally made, then admitted generative AI was used in "a very small portion" after viewers spotted AI shots at early screenings. A case study in disclosure norms for hybrid animation.

Variety's account of Roth walking back his claim that 'Ice Cream Man' contained no AI: he now says generative AI appears in "a very small portion of a few scenes." The reversal reignites the question of how studios label AI-assisted craft work.

Higgsfield signed licensing deals for AI avatars of streamer N3on, UFC's Israel Adesanya and Quinton 'Rampage' Jackson for a new feature — a test of how public figures get paid when their likeness and scripts are adapted with generative AI.

Bootleg 'The Office' and 'Friends' clips generated with China's MiniMax H3 are going viral outside China, reminding studios how hard IP policing is when a video model can reproduce a show's look, cast and staging on demand.

Bringing 'Pan's Labyrinth' back to theaters 20 years on, Guillermo del Toro insists the restoration used "no godd*mn AI" — sticking to photochemical-faithful techniques as AI upscaling and cleanup spread across archive remastering.

VFX supervisor Todd Sheridan Perry gives an honest, artist-side read on SIGGRAPH 2026 in LA — what the neural rendering, gaussian splat and AI-assisted animation demos actually mean for production pipelines.

Runway announces ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 is now available inside its platform, putting 30-second single-shot generation and 3D camera blockouts alongside Runway's own tools in one filmmaking workspace.
Corridor Crew brings in AI experts to break down how fully synthetic YouTube channels are made and how to spot them — a practical detection primer for anyone working with generated footage.
